name: Lomita City Council Meeting
agenda_text:
REGULAR MEETING OF THE LOMITA CITY COUNCIL
AGENDA
Tuesday, December 21, 2021 - 06:30 p.m.
LOMITA CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBERS
24300 Narbonne Avenue, Lomita, CA 90717
Published by the Office of the City Clerk
PURSUANT TO AB-361, THE PUBLIC AND COUNCIL MAY PARTICIPATE IN THIS MEETING VIA TELECONFERENCE AS SOCIAL DISTANCING MEASURES ARE RECOMMENDED BY STATE AND COUNTY OFFICIALS.
To participate in the meeting via a computer or smart device log in to ZOOM at the following link: https://us02web.zoom.us/j/87696044086.
You may enter your name when prompted do so. If you wish to provide public comment at either the beginning of the meeting or for a particular item, you may either (a) contact the City Clerk's Office before the meeting and provide your name or (b) utilize the "raise hand" option located under the participant's name. Once you click on this option you will be in the rotation to make a public comment.
Please note, if you do not have the audio feature on your device you will need to call (669) 900-6833 and enter ZOOM Meeting ID: 876 9604 4086 then press pound (#). When prompted to enter the participation ID number press pound (#) again. To make a public comment enter "*9". The Clerk's office will be notified, and you will be announced to make a public comment.
Written materials distributed to the City Council within 72 hours of the City Council meeting are available for public inspection immediately upon distribution via the City of Lomita website or by contacting the Deputy City Clerk at l.abbott@lomitacity.com.
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) if you need special assistance to participate in this meeting, you should contact the office of the City Clerk at (310) 325-7110 (voice) or the California Relay Service. Notification 48 hours prior to the meeting will enable the City to make reasonable arrangements to assure accessibility to this meeting.
This meeting will be conducted in compliance with CDC guidelines and applicable orders of the Los Angeles County Health Officer.
1. OPENING CEREMONIES
a)
Call Meeting to Order
b)
Flag Salute
c)
Invocation – Council Member Waronek
d)
Roll Call
e)
Closed Session Report – City Attorney
2.
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
3.
PRESENTATIONS
None Scheduled.
4.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS Persons wishing to speak on Consent Agenda items or subjects other than those scheduled are requested to do so at this time. In order to conduct a timely meeting, a five-minute time limit per person has been established. Government Code Section 54954.2 prohibits the Council from discussing or taking action on a specific item unless it appears on a posted agenda.
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS AND MEETING ATTENDANCE REPORTS FROM THE CITY COUNCIL The City Council may discuss and act upon items described under Council comments; however, items which are not on the agenda will be limited to Council reports, announcements, requests for clarification or factual information, or placement of matters on the agenda for a future meeting.
6.
CITY MANAGER’S REPORT (information only)
7.
CONSENT AGENDA
All items under the Consent Agenda are considered by the Council to be routine and will be enacted by one motion in the form listed below. There may be separate discussions of these items prior to the time the Council votes on the motion. Specific items may be removed from the Consent Agenda at the request of any Council Member or staff.
RECOMMENDED ACTION: That Consent Calendar Items 7 a-o be approved.

Approval of the 2022 Legislative Platform and Consideration of the “Brand-Huang-Mendoza Tripartisan Land Use Initiative”
RECOMMENDED ACTION: 1) Adopt Resolution 2021-43 approving the 2022 Legislative Platform; and 2) Adopt Resolution 2021-44 supporting the Brand-Huang-Mendoza Tripartisan Land Use Initiative.
RESOLUTION NO. 2021-43 - A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF LOMITA, CALIFORNIA, APPROVING THE LEGISLATIVE PLATFORM
RESOLUTION NO. 2021-44 - A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF LOMITA, CALIFORNIA, EXPRESSING SUPPORT FOR THE “BRAND-HUANG-MENDOZA TRIPARTISAN LAND USE INITIATIVE” TO AMEND ARTICLE XI OF THE CONSTITUTION OF THE STATE OF CALIFORNIA TO MAKE ZONING AND LAND USE COMMUNITY AFFAIRS, AND NOT OF STATE INTEREST
Item #7i
j.
Financial Management Policies
RECOMMENDED ACTION: At the request of the City’s Auditors, it is recommended that the City Council adopt the three attached resolutions for Financial Management Policies. These resolutions include:
1)
Credit Card Policy - RESOLUTION NO. 2021-45 - A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF LOMITA, CALIFORNIA, ESTABLISHING A CREDIT CARD ACCEPTANCE POLICY FOR THE PAYMENTS OF CITY-IMPOSED FEES, CHARGES, FINES, PERMITS, AND/OR SALES
2)
Purchasing Policy - RESOLUTION NO. 2021-46 - A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF LOMITA, CALIFORNIA, ESTABLISHING RULES AND REGULATIONS FOR THE PROCUREMENT OF GOODS, SERVICES AND CONSTRUCTION CONTRACTS AND ESTABLISHING CONTRACT EXECUTION AUTHORITY, HEREINAFTER TO BE KNOWN AS THE PURCHASING POLICY
3)
Accounts Payable Policy - RESOLUTION NO. 2021-47 - A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF LOMITA, CALIFORNIA, APPROVING ACCOUNTS PAYABLE POLICY AND REPEALING AND RESCINDING ANY PREVIOUS POLICIES OR ADMINISTRATIVE MEMORANDA RELATED TO ACCOUNTS PAYABLE
Item #7j
k.
Consider Opting into Settlement Agreements with Distributors of Opioids, Amerisource Bergen, Cardinal Health, and McKesson, and Opioid Manufacturer Janssen (owned by Johnson & Johnson)
RECOMMENDED ACTION: 1) Opt into settlement agreement with opioid distributors, Amerisource Bergen, Cardinal Health, and McKesson, and direct the City Manager to (a) allocate the City’s share of the settlement to the County of Los Angeles for the current year and in the future, unless such funds can be used cost-effectively locally, and (b) execute any documents necessary to implement the action. 2) Opt into settlement agreement with opioid manufacturer, Janssen (owned by Johnson & Johnson), and direct the City Manager to (a) allocate the City’s share of the settlement to the County of Los Angeles for the current year and in the future, unless such funds can be used cost-effectively locally, and (b) execute any documents necessary to implement the action
Item #7k
l.
Service Order with SpectrumEnterprise to Facilitate Hosting of the City’s Public Access Channel
RECOMMENDED ACTION: Authorize the City Manager to execute a three-year agreement with SpectrumEnterprise to install necessary infrastructure to facilitate hosting of the City’s Public Access Channel.
Item #7l
m.
Intent to vacate a 2,850 (15’ x 190’) square foot portion of public alley located south of 24516 Narbonne Ave.
RECOMMENDED ACTION: Adopt Resolution 2021-48 (1) declaring the intention of the City Council of the City of Lomita to vacate a portion of the public alley as identified in Exhibit A which is approximately 2,850 square feet of the public alley to the south of the property located at 24516 Narbonne Avenue, (2) Direct the City Clerk to set a hearing date, time, and place to consider testimony and evidence related to the proposed abandonment, and (3) and finding such action exempt from CEQA.
Item #7m
n.
Agreement with Project Partners for Public Works Staffing Support
RECOMMENDED ACTION: 1) Approve a Professional Services Agreement with Project Partners for engineering services related to capital projects and staff support for and amount not to exceed $175,000; and 2) Authorize the City Manager and City Clerk to execute the Agreement.
Item #7n
o.
Amend the Annual Service Level Authorization with the Los Angeles Sheriff’s Department to Add a Growth Special Assignment Deputy
RECOMMENDED ACTION: Authorize the City Manager to formally request an amendment to the Service Level Authorization to add a Growth Special Assignment Deputy at a cost not to exceed $221,123.76 (annualized).
Item #7o
SCHEDULED ITEMS
8.

Presented by Susan Kamada, Administrative Services Director
RECOMMENDED ACTION: Receive and file the Fiscal Year 2020-2021 Annual Comprehensive Financial Report (ACFR) and the Single Audit Report on Schedule of Expenditures of Federal Awards.

Presented by Carla Dillon, P.E., Public Works Director
RECOMMENDED ACTION: Adopt resolution 2021-49 declaring a Drought Response Level 1 Shortage Alert and finding the action exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act.
RESOLUTION NO. 2021-49 - A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF LOMITA, CALIFORNIA, ADOPTING A WATER SHORTAGE CONTINGENCY STAGE 1 AND FINDING THE SAME EXEMPT FROM CEQA
Item #SCH 9
PUBLIC HEARINGS
10.
DISCUSSION AND CONSIDERATION OF ZONE TEXT AMENDMENT NO. 2021-03 DEFINING A "SELF-STORAGE FACILITY" USE, ESTABLISHING A PARKING STANDARD FOR SELF-STORAGE FACILITY USES, REMOVING THE SELF-STORAGE FACILITY USE FROM THE LIST OF PERMISSIBLE USES IN THE COMMERCIAL GENERAL (C-G) ZONE, AND ALLOWING SELF-STORAGE FACILITY USE WITHIN THE LIGHT MANUFACTURING COMMERCIAL ZONE (M-C) SUBJECT TO A CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT
Presented by Greg Kapovich, Community & Economic Development Director
RECOMMENDED ACTION: After conducting a public hearing, and after the City Attorney reads the title of the ordinance, introduce on first reading Ordinance No. 828 (1) amending Sections 11-1.15, 11-1.45.02, 11-1.51.05, and 11-1.66.03 to define and establish parking requirements for a self-storage facility use and remove self-storage facilities from being an allowed use in the Commercial General (C-G) Zone and instead allow self-storage facilities as a conditionally permitted use in the Light Manufacturing Commercial (M-C) Zone, and (2) finding the action is categorically exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act.
ORDINANCE NO. 828 - AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF LOMITA, CALIFORNIA, AMENDING LOMITA MUNICIPAL CODE SECTIONS 11-1.15, 11-1.45.02, 11-1.51.05, AND 11-1.66.03 TO DEFINE AND ESTABLISH PARKING REQUIREMENTS FOR A SELF-STORAGE FACILITY USE AND REMOVE THE SELF-STORAGE FACILITIES FROM BEING AN ALLOWED USE IN THE COMMERCIAL GENERAL (C-G) ZONE AND INSTEAD ALLOW SELF-STORAGE FACILITIES AS A CONDITIONALLY PERMITTED USE IN THE LIGHT MANUFACTURING COMMERCIAL (M-C) ZONE, AND FINDING THE SAME EXEMPT FROM CEQA (First Reading)
Item # PH 10
11.
DISCUSSION AND CONSIDERATION TO APPROVE A RESOLUTION ADOPTING THE GENERAL PLAN AMENDMENT 2021-02 FOR THE 2021 SAFETY ELEMENT UPDATE
Presented by Greg Kapovich, Community & Economic Development Director
RECOMMENDED ACTION: Adopt Resolution 2021-50, approving General Plan Amendment 2021-02 for the Safety Element Update.
RESOLUTION NO. 2021-50 - A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF LOMITA, CALIFORNIA, ADOPTING GENERAL PLAN AMENDMENT NO. 2021-02 FOR THE SAFETY ELEMENT, MAKING FINDINGS RELATED HERETO, AND ADOPTING A NEGATIVE DECLARATION

Presented by Greg Kapovich, Community & Economic Development Director
RECOMMENDED ACTION: Adopt Resolution 2021-51, approving General Plan Amendment 2021-03 for the 2021-2029 Housing Element Update.
RESOLUTION NO. 2021-51 - A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF LOMITA, CALIFORNIA, APPROVING GENERAL PLAN AMENDMENT NO. 2021-03 FOR THE 2021-2029 HOUSING ELEMENT, MAKING FINDINGS RELATED THERETO, AND ADOPTING AN INITIAL STUDY AND NEGATIVE DECLARATION

Due to the holiday schedule, the January 4, 2022, City Council meeting has been cancelled. The next regular meeting is scheduled for Tuesday, January 18, 2022, at 6:00 p.m.
